That is totally doable! The code to add to special slot 3 is here:

pockets._props.Slots[2]._props.filters[0].Filter.push(“groovey_fannypack”);

To update it to use slot 2 instead of 3, change _props.Slots[2] to _props.Slots[1]

The special slots are named 0, 1 and 2.

comments.author: Kilo_Lee
comments.body_html:
Hey y’all.

Thought I’d do some due diligence and help some of y’all out.

Context:

I use 1.0.1 version of this mod.

I have 3.7.4 SPT.

Issue I was having:

Loading into any map with raiders and Glukhar Boss and his followers will spit out the following errors:

  1. TypeError:Cannot read properties ofundefined(reading ‘item’)
  2. TypeError:Cannot read properties ofundefined(reading ‘item’)
  3. at WeightedRandomHelper.getWeightedValue (C:\snapshot\project\src\helpers\WeightedRandomHelper.ts:27:27)
  4. at BotInventoryGenerator.generateEquipment (C:\snapshot\project\src\generators\BotInventoryGenerator.ts:212:64)
  5. at BotInventoryGenerator.generateAndAddEquipmentToBot (C:\snapshot\project\src\generators\BotInventoryGenerator.ts:168:18)
  6. at BotInventoryGenerator.generateInventory (C:\snapshot\project\src\generators\BotInventoryGenerator.ts:70:14)
  7. at BotGenerator.generateBot (C:\snapshot\project\src\generators\BotGenerator.ts:177:52)
  8. at BotGenerator.prepareAndGenerateBots (C:\snapshot\project\src\generators\BotGenerator.ts:118:24)
  9. at BotController.generate (C:\snapshot\project\src\controllers\BotController.ts:181:64)
  10. at BotCallbacks.generateBots (C:\snapshot\project\src\callbacks\BotCallbacks.ts:55:61)
  11. at RouteAction.action (C:\snapshot\project\src\routers\static\BotStaticRouter.ts:20:50)
  12. at BotStaticRouter.handleStatic (C:\snapshot\project\src\di\Router.ts:51:61)

I managed to troubleshoot and track down this mod to be the culprit.

Scavs and PMCs spawned fine with all items from this mod.

It was Raiders and Glukhar that was having issues specifically.

This in turn broke spawns for Raiders and Glukhar.

My Fix

*I personally only wanted Scavs to have these items.*

(IE. Scavs to only be able to spawn with FannyPacks and SmallCases).*

You can go to the mod.ts files for both aSmallCases and aFannyPack and edit the lines of codes that gives items to the Bots.

The mod.ts files will be located in:

  • user/mods/aFannyPack/src
  • user/mods/aSmallCases/src

Edit with notepad and find the lines that says // add case to bots.

You can comment out the lines for the bots that you DON’T want.

IE.

----------------------------------------

// add case to bots

const weightingMult = 1.0

const botTypes = [

// “usec”,

// “bear”,

// “pmcbot”,

“assault”

];

----------------------------------------

This will prevent the respective bots to NOT spawn with the mod items.

Raiders and Glukhar started spawning for me now.

==================================================

Keep in mind, this fixed it for me.

It may not help you but it might be worth a shot for you.

Cheers.
